name: H&E VAE

evaluations.protocol: Latest training validation · 256px · tile count not recorded

configuration:
seed: 42
output_dir: <local path>
data:
  root: <local path>
  train_manifest: train_dataframe.csv
  val_manifest: val_dataframe.csv
  crop_size: 256
  workers: 8
  timeout: 300
vae:
  base_channels: 64
  latent_channels: 8
loss:
  l1: 1.0
  ssim: 0.2
  lpips: 0.25
  kl: 1.0e-06
  gan: 0.05
adversarial:
  base_channels: 64
  lr: 0.0002
  warmup_epochs: 3
validation:
  batches: 20
  patience: 8
  min_delta: 0.0001
  warmup_epochs: 10
train:
  epochs: 40
  batch_size: 16
  lr: 0.0002
  log_every: 50
time_definition: Historical Slurm training-job elapsed time. Includes setup, validation and I/O; excludes separate pretraining, parent runs and other continuation allocations.
